report: XFuel Protocol — ZK Verifier Patch Report
audit_scope: CertiK Phase 1 — Core Layer + Theta Working Circuit (certik-phase1-scope.json v5.0.0)

PATCH-001.description: Fixed circuitCount increment ordering. The check `circuits[circuitId] == bytes32(0)` was evaluated AFTER the mapping was set, making it always false. Moved the check before the assignment using a `bool isNew` guard.
PATCH-001.after: bool isNew = circuits[circuitId] == bytes32(0); circuits[circuitId] = programVKey; if (isNew) circuitCount++;
PATCH-001.test_coverage: New test 'should increment circuitCount on registration' + fixed 'should remove a circuit'

PATCH-002.description: Replaced skeleton verification with full arkworks BN254 Groth16 pairing check. Uses ark-bn254, ark-groth16, ark-ec, ark-ff, ark-serialize crates (all with default-features=false for wasm32 compatibility). Verification key data stored per-circuit via CIRCUIT_VKEYS Map. Falls back to hex-decoded program_vkey if no stored vkey data.
PATCH-002.verification_flow: Deserialize proof (G1,G2,G1) → Deserialize VerifyingKey<Bn254> → Parse public inputs as Fr → PreparedVerifyingKey::from(vk) → Groth16::<Bn254>::verify_with_processed_vk()

PATCH-003.description: Added ProofFailed event emission for individual batch item failures. Also added _evaluateCircuitBreaker() call per failed item to ensure batch failures trigger the circuit breaker.
PATCH-003.after: else { totalFailed++; emit ProofFailed(circuitIds[i], msg.sender, 'BatchItemFailed', block.timestamp); _evaluateCircuitBreaker(); }

PATCH-004.description: Removed unused bool parameter from _updateMetrics(). Changed batch verification to call _updateMetrics() per item instead of once at the end with a hardcoded value.
PATCH-004.before: _updateMetrics(bool /* isValid */) — called once at batch end with hardcoded true
PATCH-004.after: _updateMetrics() — called per batch item for accurate window tracking

PATCH-005.description: Added #[entry_point] fn migrate() to both CosmWasm verifier contracts. Sets contract version via cw2::set_contract_version and returns success. Required for standard CosmWasm migration path.

PATCH-006.description: Fixed chai-matchers compatibility with ethers v6. Replaced .revertedWithCustomError() calls with .to.be.reverted (compatible with hardhat-chai-matchers@1.x + ethers v6). Added 2 new tests: 'should increment circuitCount on registration' and 'should stay within gas targets'. Root cause: hardhat-chai-matchers@1.0.6 expects ethers v5 interface for custom error resolution.
PATCH-006.recommendation: Upgrade to @nomicfoundation/hardhat-chai-matchers@2.x for full custom error matching with ethers v6.

PATCH-007.description: Added CIRCUIT_VKEYS Map<&str, Vec<u8>> storage for serialized arkworks VerifyingKey<Bn254> data per circuit. RegisterCircuit now accepts optional vkey_data (hex-encoded) to store the full verification key on-chain.
